scope: All reachable public struct/enum/trait/type paths of tekes_ui_controls, including explicit aliases. Functions/constants and other crates are outside this type audit.
review_policy: Every new public type path requires explicit classification and rationale. Component implementations bind existing registry identity/routes; composition adapters and aliases use existing family routes, not new components. Public implementation helpers remain publicly callable, not private APIs. Classification is a reviewed semantic decision, not inferred from a name or a compiler pass. Optional non-Gallery components and owner-local support stay explicit with their actual Cargo feature; generated public bindings follow selected features. This is a reviewed feature boundary, not a general cfg proof.
